title: Carbon Dioxide Insufflation on Cerebral Microemboli
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if blowing carbon dioxide into the surgical field during open-heart surgery to displace retained chest cavity air from the atmosphere will decrease the number of microembolic being introduced into the heart chambers and brain.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* provide informed consent
* male or female who are 18 years of age or older
* elective patients to undergo mitral valve repair +/- coronary artery bypass surgery
* ability to read and write

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with a history of stroke, TIA, carotid vascular disease
* patients with a contraindication to TEE or MRI
* patients with an active history of drug/alcohol dependence or abuse history
